passage: Counsellor's note. Farhan came to see me after class with red ears. He said quietly, "I watched a video I knew I shouldn't. It was meant for older people. I feel really embarrassed, and I thought you'd tell my father and I'd be in trouble." I thanked him for telling me and said that being curious is normal. I explained in simple words that some videos are for adults, not children, and answered the two questions he asked. I asked whether he'd like to tell his father with me beside him. He said yes. Afterwards his father listened, thanked him for being honest, and did not punish him. Farhan's shoulders dropped. — Mr Naveen, school counsellor

qa.q: What colour were Farhan's ears when he came to the counsellor?
What was Farhan afraid of when he came to see the counsellor?
qa.a: He felt embarrassed and thought he would be in trouble, since he assumed the counsellor would tell his father and he would be punished.

qa.q: How did Mr Naveen help Farhan feel safe again?
qa.a: He thanked Farhan for telling him, said curiosity is normal, answered his questions simply, and stayed beside him when he told his father.

qa.q: How might Farhan's father have felt hearing this?
qa.a: Probably concerned, but glad his son was honest, since he thanked Farhan and did not punish him.

grounding: A child ashamed of watching something unsuitable tells a trusted adult and is helped without being punished.

passage:
Friday: A video Irawati was watching ended, and the next one started on its own. It was a grown-up video with people shouting and hurting each other. She knew she should close it, but she kept watching for a minute. Then she slammed the tablet shut, cheeks burning, and told no one.
Saturday: The pictures kept coming back at bedtime. She hid the tablet under her cupboard and snapped at her cousin Yamini for no reason.
Sunday: While Mummy was folding clothes, Irawati whispered, "I saw something bad on the tablet. I'm sorry." Mummy stopped folding and sat beside her. "Thank you for telling me. You're not in trouble. Tell me what you saw." Irawati told her. Mummy explained it gently, and that evening they set up the child settings together. Irawati slept without the pictures that night.

qa.q: How did the grown-up video start playing?
qa.a: The next video started on its own after the one Irawati was watching ended.

qa.q: What did Irawati's snapping at Yamini suggest?
qa.a: She felt ashamed and upset about the secret, and it came out as crossness.

qa.q: What did Mummy do that helped Irawati feel safe again?
qa.a: She thanked her, said she was not in trouble, listened, explained gently and set up child settings together that evening.

qa.q: How might Yamini have felt when Irawati snapped at her?
qa.a: Yamini was probably confused and a bit hurt, not knowing Irawati was carrying a secret.

grounding: A girl embarrassed after watching something she should not have tells a trusted adult, who explains it and helps her feel safe without punishing her.

passage: Keerthana, you've been hiding the phone under your pillow and not looking at me. Let me tell you something first. When your Vishal Mama was about ten, my friend's older brother put on a video at their house, a grown-up film with things I knew I shouldn't see. I watched anyway, because I was curious. Afterwards I felt sick and ashamed for days. I couldn't even eat my Amma's dosa. Finally I told my father. I thought he would shout. He only said, "Being curious is normal. Thank you for telling me," and he talked with me about what I'd seen until I stopped feeling scared. So, kanna, did you see something like that? ... Okay. Thank you for telling me. You are not in trouble at all. Come, we'll tell your Amma together, right now.

qa.q: Whom did young Vishal finally tell?
How did young Vishal feel in the days after the film?
qa.a: Sick and ashamed; he could not even eat his Amma's dosa.

qa.q: What was the turning point in Mama's story?
qa.a: Telling his father, who said curiosity is normal and talked with him until he stopped feeling scared.

qa.q: How might Vishal's father have felt when his son told him?
qa.a: Probably concerned but calm, and glad his son trusted him enough to tell.

grounding: An uncle recalls feeling ashamed after watching something he should not have and how telling a parent helped, then responds the same way to the child listening.
